test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Many groups like the 'Narmada Bachao Andolan' oppose building of big dams. What is the negative social impact of a big dam that such groups oppose?

options.text: It causes flash floods in the downstream area.
It leads to conflicts between people of different States.
People have to wait for many years (decades) to get benefits.
It displaces people in the upstream reservoir area.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It displaces people in the upstream reservoir area.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• **Environmentalists **and **human rights **advocates have been **protesting **the **construction **of **dams **across the **Narmada** River as part of the **Narmada Bachao Andolan **(NBA) social movement.
 
• Numerous well-known persons are involved in the movement and are fighting against the uprooting of the **populace **and for their **rehabilitation**.
 
• The construction of such a project will result in **widespread violations **of **human rights **and the **eviction **of the **vulnerable **and **impoverished**, according to the **justification **for the **protest**.
 
• The **multipurpose Sardar Sarovar Project **has a price because it impacts the locals who are being **forcibly evicted**.
 
• **245 villages **from these states were predicted to be flooded during the **dam's construction**.
 
• About **2.5 lakh residents **from these villages had to be relocated. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• The **Narmada Bachao Andolan**, an Indian social movement led by **local tribal people, farmers, environmentalists, **and** human rights advocates, **has been protesting a number of huge dam projects across the **Narmada River**, which flows through the states: **Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, **and **Maharashtra.**
 
• The **Sardar Sarovar Dam **in **Gujarat**, one of the **largest dams **on the river, was one of the movement's initial focal areas.
 
• It is a part of the **Narmada Dam Project**, which aims to provide irrigation and energy to the people of the **aforementioned states**.
 
• **Legal actions, hunger strikes, protests, **and** soliciting the aid** of well-known personalities in the film and art industries are just a few of **NBA's campaign strategies.**
 
• With notable spokespersons **Medha** **Patkar **and **Baba Amte **present, the NBA was presented with the **Right Livelihood Award.**
